```{R}
twas_path <- "../4-twas"

all_twas  <- list()

# List all subdirectories inside the main directory
subdirs <- list.dirs(twas_path, recursive = FALSE)
subdirs <- subdirs[subdirs != "../4-twas/bsb2026"]
subdirs <- subdirs[subdirs != "../4-twas/jad"]

# Loop through each subdirectory
for (subdir in subdirs) {

  analyses_genes <- list()
  unique_genes <- c()
  
  # Find the CSV file in the subdirectory
  csv_files <- list.files(subdir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  # If there's at least one CSV file, read it
  if (length(csv_files) > 0) {
    csv_path <- csv_files[1]  # Assuming there's only one CSV per folder
    
    # Extract the file name without extension
    file_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(csv_path))
    
    data <- read.csv(csv_path, header = TRUE)
    
    for (col in colnames(data)){
      genes <- unique(data[[col]])
      analyses_genes[[col]] <- genes
      unique_genes <- unique(c(unique_genes, genes))
    }
    
    all_twas[[file_name]] <- unique_genes
    
  } else {
    warning(paste("No CSV file found in", subdir))
  }
}
```

```{R}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

all_targets <- read.csv("all_targets.csv", header = FALSE)$V1

intro_papers <- read_xlsx("intro_papers.xlsx")

comparisons <- list()
# Create table
target_table <- data.frame(
  target = all_targets,
  intro_papers = NA_character_,
  twas_papers = NA_character_
)

# Search intro papers
for (i in seq_along(all_targets)) {
  
  target <- all_targets[i]
  
  matching_papers <- names(intro_papers)[
    sapply(intro_papers, function(x) target %in% x)
  ]
  
  comparisons[[target]] <- matching_papers
  
  target_table$intro_papers[i] <- paste(matching_papers, collapse = "; ")
}

# Search TWAS papers
for (i in seq_along(all_targets)) {
  
  target <- all_targets[i]
  
  matching_papers <- names(all_twas)[
    sapply(all_twas, function(x) target %in% x)
  ]
  
  target_table$twas_papers[i] <- paste(matching_papers, collapse = "; ")
  
  comparisons[[target]] <- c(comparisons[[target]], matching_papers)
}
```

```{R}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# 1. Load DEG RData objects
load("/home/gbiuser/Documents/vitoria/usp-masters/3-snrnaseq/sct/degs_sct_novo/degs_f.RData")
load("/home/gbiuser/Documents/vitoria/usp-masters/3-snrnaseq/sct/degs_sct_celltype/GSE213982_celltype_f.RData")
load("/home/gbiuser/Documents/vitoria/usp-masters/3-snrnaseq/sct/degs_sct_celltype/GSE144136_celltype_f.RData")

# Ensure rownames are gene names for pseudobulk data frames if needed
rownames(degs_GSE144136_f) <- degs_GSE144136_f$X
rownames(degs_GSE213982_f) <- degs_GSE213982_f$X

# Load target genes
all_targets <- read.csv("all_targets.csv", header = FALSE)$V1
intro_papers <- read_xlsx("intro_papers.xlsx")

# 2. Build base target table
target_table <- data.frame(
  target = all_targets,
  intro_papers = NA_character_,
  twas_papers = NA_character_,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Search Intro Papers
for (i in seq_along(all_targets)) {
  target <- all_targets[i]
  matching_papers <- names(intro_papers)[sapply(intro_papers, function(x) target %in% x)]
  target_table$intro_papers[i] <- paste(matching_papers, collapse = "; ")
}

# Search TWAS Papers (assuming all_twas is present in your session)
for (i in seq_along(all_targets)) {
  target <- all_targets[i]
  matching_papers <- names(all_twas)[sapply(all_twas, function(x) target %in% x)]
  target_table$twas_papers[i] <- paste(matching_papers, collapse = "; ")
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Add DEG Information (Pseudobulk & Cell Types)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------

# Helper function to query fold change from a list or dataframe safely
get_log2fc <- function(deg_obj, gene) {
  if (is.data.frame(deg_obj)) {
    if (gene %in% rownames(deg_obj)) return(deg_obj[gene, "avg_log2FC"])
  } else if (is.list(deg_obj)) {
    # If cell type list, return named vector of fold changes per cell type
    res <- sapply(deg_obj, function(df) {
      if (gene %in% rownames(df)) return(df[gene, "avg_log2FC"]) else return(NA)
    })
    return(res[!is.na(res)])
  }
  return(numeric(0))
}

# Add empty columns to store DEG results
target_table$DEGs_GSE144136 <- NA_character_
target_table$DEGs_GSE213982 <- NA_character_
target_table$consistent_degs       <- NA_character_

for (i in seq_along(all_targets)) {
  gene <- all_targets[i]
  
  # --- Process GSE144136 ---
  deg_144136 <- c()
  fc_144136  <- c() # Store fold changes to evaluate consistency later
  
  # Check pseudobulk
  fc_pb <- get_log2fc(degs_GSE144136_f, gene)
  if (length(fc_pb) > 0) {
    dir <- ifelse(fc_pb > 0, "up", "down")
    deg_144136 <- c(deg_144136, paste0("pb(", dir, ")"))
    fc_144136["pb"] <- fc_pb
  }
  
  # Check cell types
  fc_ct <- get_log2fc(GSE144136_celltype_filtered, gene)
  if (length(fc_ct) > 0) {
    for (ct in names(fc_ct)) {
      dir <- ifelse(fc_ct[ct] > 0, "up", "down")
      deg_144136 <- c(deg_144136, paste0(ct, "(", dir, ")"))
      fc_144136[ct] <- fc_ct[ct]
    }
  }
  
  # --- Process GSE213982 ---
  deg_213982 <- c()
  fc_213982  <- c()
  
  # Check pseudobulk
  fc_pb <- get_log2fc(degs_GSE213982_f, gene)
  if (length(fc_pb) > 0) {
    dir <- ifelse(fc_pb > 0, "up", "down")
    deg_213982 <- c(deg_213982, paste0("pb(", dir, ")"))
    fc_213982["pb"] <- fc_pb
  }
  
  # Check cell types
  fc_ct <- get_log2fc(GSE213982_celltype_filtered, gene)
  if (length(fc_ct) > 0) {
    for (ct in names(fc_ct)) {
      dir <- ifelse(fc_ct[ct] > 0, "up", "down")
      deg_213982 <- c(deg_213982, paste0(ct, "(", dir, ")"))
      fc_213982[ct] <- fc_ct[ct]
    }
  }
  
  # --- Evaluate Concordance/Consistency across datasets ---
  common_contexts <- intersect(names(fc_144136), names(fc_213982))
  consistent_list <- c()
  
  for (ctx in common_contexts) {
    # Check if signs are the same
    if (sign(fc_144136[ctx]) == sign(fc_213982[ctx])) {
      dir <- ifelse(fc_144136[ctx] > 0, "up", "down")
      consistent_list <- c(consistent_list, paste0(ctx, "(", dir, ")"))
    }
  }
  
  # --- Populate row data ---
  target_table$DEGs_GSE144136[i] <- paste(deg_144136, collapse = "; ")
  target_table$DEGs_GSE213982[i] <- paste(deg_213982, collapse = "; ")
  target_table$consistent_degs[i]       <- paste(consistent_list, collapse = "; ")
}
```

```{R}
# Add DEG information to comparisons
for (i in seq_along(all_targets)) {
  
  target <- all_targets[i]
  
  # Check whether the target was found as a DEG in either dataset
  is_deg <- nzchar(target_table$DEGs_GSE144136[i]) ||
            nzchar(target_table$DEGs_GSE213982[i])
  
  if (is_deg) {
    comparisons[[target]] <- c(comparisons[[target]], "DEG")
  }
}

comparisons <- comparisons[order(
  lengths(comparisons),
  decreasing = TRUE
)]
```
